subject: Compliance-driven deployment options and evidence next steps
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@wellwellhealth.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@wellwellhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance-driven deployment options and evidence next steps

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for taking time today — good call. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we keep momentum with your Q4 audit window: 

Recap (what we heard)
- WellWell will process PHI in the initial pilot (claims + clinical notes).
- Audit window: external audit scheduled for the week of Oct 18, 2027.
- Required evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), BAA in place, network diagrams, encryption-at-rest certs, and access logs for the last 90 days.

Initial recommendation (based on requirements)
- Short term: Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) — predictable isolation and SLA, can be provisioned with customer tenancy policies. Estimated provisioning: 10–14 business days once we confirm committed capacity and network info.
- Long term / if audit requires stricter controls: Private (VPC with customer-managed networking or on‑prem appliance) — longer lead time (4–6 weeks) but gives maximum control for auditors.
- Hosted API: fastest to start but requires an approved BAA and selective controls; may not satisfy WellWell if auditors require full customer-controlled networking.

What we will send by EOD: a short evidence checklist (attached) and a provisioning matrix with timeline estimates for Dedicated vs Private.

Ask from you: please confirm two things so we can size the solution and prioritize artifacts: 1) Are you planning to process PHI in the pilot (confirmed on call = yes)? 2) Who on your security team should we loop in for the deeper evidence exchange and network details (name/email)?

Next steps we propose:
- I’ll send the evidence checklist + provisioning matrix (attached).
- Sign the BAA draft (DocuSign link to follow) — this unlocks Hosted/Dedicated options.
- Schedule a security deep-dive (30–45m) with your security lead and our infra/security engineers — ideally next week.

Attachments: security-evidence-checklist.xlsx, dedicated-provisioning-matrix.pdf

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance-driven deployment options and evidence next steps

Diego — quick internal notes based on Samira's ask and the call: 

- Confirmed PHI processing means we should push Dedicated as the default MLP for the pilot. It gives isolation and we can scope a tighter network ACL + customer IP allow list without the longer lead time of a full Private on‑prem.
- Evidence we can provide quickly (48–72h): SOC2 Type II redacted PDF, encryption-at-rest cert statement, syslog access details (limited range), and our standard access-control matrix. I’ll pull the redacted SOC2 and the redaction summary.
- For Private/VPC: we’ll need network CIDRs, peering/VPN type (customer-managed VPN vs AWS Transit Gateway), and whether they require HSM/KMS integration. That will push timeline out ~4 weeks for full delivery and validation testing.
- SLA/throughput ask: ask Samira for expected concurrent calls and RPS; that determines GPU tiering and whether Dedicated pool needs burst capacity.

I’ll assemble the short evidence bundle and share a secure Drive link. Diego — can you confirm we want to propose a 2‑phase plan in the reply: Phase 1 = Dedicated provision + evidence exchange; Phase 2 = Private/VPC if auditor requires?

Marissa
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira@wellwellhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@wellwellhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance-driven deployment options and evidence next steps

Thanks Diego — that summary matches our notes. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed: pilot will process PHI (de‑identified later for analytics, but PHI at runtime).
- Audit window: week of Oct 18 is locked — we need evidence and preliminary env details by Oct 1 to route through our internal audit prep.
- Our auditor typically requires: full SOC2 Type II (redacted ok for some items), copy of BAA, network diagram showing isolation, proof of key management, and last 90 days of relevant access logs.

Preference: We’d like to start with Dedicated capacity for the pilot to reduce audit risk, but if your timeline for Private/VPC is within 4–6 weeks and you can provide a migration plan, we'd consider committing to Private after the pilot.

Can you send the SOC2 redacted PDF and the provisioning timeline by tomorrow EOD? Also send the DocuSign BAA so our legal team can review.

Samira
Head of Security & Privacy, WellWell Health
samira@wellwellhealth.com | +1 (206) 555-0283

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@wellwellhealth.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@wellwellhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance-driven deployment options and evidence next steps

Samira — thanks, we’ll move fast. Confirming the plan and attached materials below.

Recommended approach (summary)
Phase 1 — Pilot (short-term): Redwood Dedicated
- Why: predictable isolation, SLA, and quickest path to meet audit evidence requirements while preserving stronger network controls than public Hosted.
- Expected provisioning: 10 business days after committed capacity + network details and signed BAA.

Phase 2 — Harden/Migrate (conditional): Private VPC / customer-managed networking
- Why: if the auditor explicitly requests customer-controlled networking and proof of tenant isolation, migrate after pilot.
- Expected timeline: 4–6 weeks (network validation, peering/VPN testing, and audit replay).

Immediate deliverables (attached / links)
- security-evidence-checklist.xlsx (attached) — checklist mapping WellWell asks to Redwood artifacts.
- SOC2-Type2-redacted.pdf (attached) — redacted report for SOC2 Type II.
- dedicated-provisioning-matrix.pdf (attached) — what we need (CIDR, egress rules, expected RPS).
- BAA-template.docx (attached) — we’ll send DocuSign, you can route to your legal team.

Action items and owners
- Diego (me): send DocuSign BAA link and HubSpot deal + schedule security deep-dive.
- Marissa: share redacted SOC2 + access log extraction instructions (target: tomorrow EOD).
- Samira/WellWell: confirm expected RPS/concurrency and provide network contact for VPN/CIDR details.

Proposed next meeting: 30–45m security deep-dive on Wed 2027-09-15 at 10:00 AM PT (I’ll send an invite). Please confirm availability.

DocuSign / HubSpot
- DocuSign BAA draft: https://www.docusign.com/BAA/RDW-2027-1298
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.example/deal/RDW-2027-1298

Attachments: security-evidence-checklist.xlsx, SOC2-Type2-redacted.pdf, dedicated-provisioning-matrix.pdf, BAA-template.docx

Thanks — we’ll treat the Oct 1 evidence cutoff as high priority.

Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Diego@redwood.ai
